name: Alchemy
summary: Still the profession for elixirs, flasks and buffing consumables. New in Forever: portable Alchemy Laboratories (flasks no longer need Scholomance), dyes, new recipes such as Minor Arcane Elixir and Elixir of the Grizzly, and Healing Potions moved to First Aid.
tips: Pair with Herbalism, which supplies nearly every herb you need
Vials are sold by vendors in stacks of five, pricier each tier
Fishing supplies the odd fish used in some oils
Camp objects: Mana Well (mana regen), Fermenter and Alchemy Laboratory (workstations)
Legacy Working Overtime raises skill-up chance; Dedicated Study gives free points to your lowest profession

name: Blacksmithing
summary: Slow and material-hungry to level, but very rewarding at the top end. Forever overhauled the recipes, added hundreds of new plans (Merchant's Favor vendors and dungeon/raid drops), camp objects and a new crafting window, and stones now stack with poisons, enchants and totems.
tips: Pair with Mining for Copper Bars and Rough Stone
Most items need an anvil, but camp objects, weapon stones and most reagents can be made anywhere
Sharpening Stones and Weightstones stack with poisons, Windfury Weapon and Windfury Totem
Recipe arrows: orange always skills up, yellow usually, green rarely
Trainers are in most settlements and every major city

name: Enchanting
summary: Still enhances gear, and now also makes spell power wands, weapons, relics, idols, totems and necklace enchants, sold through the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.
tips: Disenchant green-or-better gear for materials (destroys the item)
Material quality depends on item level
Runed Rods come from Blacksmithing
Tailoring pairs well: its early gear is great to disenchant
Fishing crates contain gear to disenchant and clams with pearls

name: Engineering
summary: Trades easy levelling and money for gadgets, bombs and consumable buffs. Forever adds child-proofed 'Saf-T' explosives anyone can throw, a Satchel of Copper Bombs, a Desolace-only foot pedal, Clanking Cord belts, and Reagent Bot, Repair Bot and Anarchist's Workbench camp objects.
tips: Keep the parts you make: low-level parts reappear in later recipes
The trainer teaches the Arclight Spanner, required for complex recipes
Mining supplies most materials; Alchemy suits some Forever recipes
Goblin/Gnomish specialisation needs 200 skill and a quest; switching means relevelling
Some top recipes need the Anarchist's Workbench camp object

name: Tailoring
summary: Makes cloth gear and bags, and its camp Faction Banner gives a Divine Spirit-style buff. Red Linen Bag now has 8 slots, new Linen and Woolen Reagent Bags were added, and new gear comes from Merchant's Favor vendors and low-level dungeon recipe drops.
route: Linen Cloth: humanoids level 1-19
Wool Cloth: level 15-30
Silk Cloth: level 26-40
Mageweave: level 41-50
Runecloth: level 51-60
tips: Disenchant early Tailoring gear for Enchanting or sell it for cloth money
Fishing crates contain bolts of cloth
Cloth must be made into bolts first; some recipes need the Spinning Wheel or Loom camp objects

name: Leatherworking
summary: Makes Leather and Mail armour, bags, quivers, reagent bags and armour kits. Forever keeps many Classic patterns and adds hundreds of new ones from 1 to 300, including enhanced Forceful and Mystic Rugged Armor Kits.
tips: Keep spare leather and hides: older materials come back in later recipes
A Salt Shaker turns Deeprock Salt into Refined Deeprock Salt every 3 days (for Cured Rugged Hides)
Pair with Skinning
The Camp Tent gives 5% of a level in Rested XP; Tanning Rack and Sewing Machine are workstations

name: Mining
summary: Classic pickaxe-and-Find-Minerals gathering, but ore respawns faster when more players are around, veins can hold more valuable minerals, and there are new bars such as Azerothium. Junior Mining Trainers in every starter zone (e.g. Kelsey Fargo in Northshire).
route: 1-70: Copper in every starting area (Poor Copper Veins from level 1); start Tin at 65
70-115: Tin and Copper (smelt Bronze) in Westfall, Silverpine, The Barrens, Loch Modan
115-175: Silver, Iron, Gold in Arathi Highlands, Alterac Mountains, Stranglethorn, Thousand Needles
175-230: Mithril in Badlands, Searing Gorge, Feralas, Tanaris, The Hinterlands
230-245: Dark Iron in Searing Gorge and Burning Steppes
245-275: Small Thorium in Winterspring, the Plaguelands, Feralas, Silithus, Un'Goro
275-300: Small and Rich Thorium; Azerothium Bar smelting from 275
tips: Keep Find Minerals on outside cities, and watch the minimap from flight paths
Rockslicer (Rhahk'Zor, Deadmines) mines Copper to Iron without the profession (30 uses)
Glove enchants, Miner's Cape and Goblin Mining Helm add skill
Camp objects: Lodestone (attack power), Rock Garden (spawns ore), Molten Foundry

name: Herbalism
summary: Gathers herbs mainly for Alchemy. Forever adds Scarce herbs, new herbs, seeds for your own camp Greenhouse, and the Incense Candle, Fermenter and Seed Hybridizer camp objects; First Aid now makes healing potions.
route: Starter zones: Peacebloom, Silverleaf, Earthroot
Level 10-20 zones: Mageroyal, Briarthorn, Stranglekelp
Level 20-30 zones: Bruiseweed, Wild Steelbloom, Kingsblood, Liferoot
Level 30-40 zones: Fadeleaf, Goldthorn, Khadgar's Whisker
Level 40-50 zones (Hinterlands best): Purple Lotus, Firebloom, Sungrass, Golden Sansam, Ghost Mushroom
Level 50-60 zones: Gromsblood, Dreamfoil, Mountain Silversage, Plaguebloom, Icecap, Black Lotus
tips: Goldthorn Tea gives +15 Herbalism
Legacy Bountiful Harvest boosts Scarce herbs
Earthroot grows on hills, Stranglekelp underwater, Ghost Mushroom in caves, Grave Moss by graves
Tauren Cultivation duplicates a herb

name: Skinning
summary: Collects leather, hides and scales for Leatherworking or the Auction House. Forever adds Fel and Pristine leathers and the Camp Chair (crit buff), Field Guide (track beasts) and Trapper's Workbench camp objects.
route: 1-75: starter zones (including Zephras Isle)
75-115: Northern Barrens, Silverpine / Loch Modan, Darkshore, Westfall, Redridge
115-150: Southern Barrens, Wetlands, Hillsbrad, Ashenvale, Duskwood
150-205: Thousand Needles, Arathi, Desolace, Alterac, Stranglethorn, Riverglades, Dustwallow, Badlands
205-260: Feralas, Tanaris, Hinterlands, Searing Gorge, Azshara
260-300: Un'Goro, Blasted Lands, Felwood, Plaguelands, Winterspring, Silithus
tips: You only need a Skinning Knife in your bags
Train new ranks at 75, 125 and 200 skill
Skin while questing rather than making trips
Glove enchants and the Keen Skinning Knife add skill

name: Cooking 1-300
summary: Level Cooking mostly from fished and looted ingredients with cheap vendor recipes. Cooking makes campfires for the Camping system, and cooked food now gives a Well Fed XP bonus.
route: 1-50: Brilliant Smallfish (about 55, starter-zone waters)
50-100: Longjaw Mud Snapper (recipe in Ironforge or Thunder Bluff)
100-150: Bristle Whisker Catfish (Stormwind, Ratchet or Thunder Bluff)
150-175: buy Expert Cookbook (Ashenvale or Desolace), then Curiously Tasty Omelet with Raptor Eggs
175-225: Mithril Head Trout
225-250: Artisan via Clamlette Surprise quest in Tanaris, then Filet of Redgill (Booty Bay)
250-300: Poached Sunscale Salmon (Steamwheedle Port, Tanaris)
trainers: Alliance: Alegorn (Darnassus), Daryl Riknussun (Ironforge), Stephen Ryback (Stormwind). Horde: Aska Mistrunner (Thunder Bluff), Eunice Burch (Undercity), Zamja (Orgrimmar).
tips: Level Fishing alongside Cooking
Use the 'Has skill up' filter
Gather Clamlette Surprise ingredients before taking the quest

name: First Aid
summary: Still makes bandages from cloth, and in Forever also makes instant, in-combat healing potions plus curatives for poison, disease and bleeds (the new curatives can't be used in combat).
route: Linen: mobs 1-19
Wool: 15-30
Silk: 26-40
Mageweave: 41-50
Runecloth: 51-60
Felcloth: demons 50-60
tips: Healing potions need a vial, spices and Peacebloom, Briarthorn or Bruiseweed
Legacy Field Medicine speeds up bandaging
Pair with Herbalism

name: Fishing
summary: Close to Classic, plus Uncommon and Rare fish, Fish Bowl / Fishing Rack / Fishing Hut camp objects, a Chef's Knife for Unique Fish, a Bait and Tackle crafting menu, Fishing-skill food and a tournament where several players can win.
tips: Lures add temporary skill
Legacy talents Working Overtime, Luremaster and Dedicated Study help
Fish Bowl gives a Blessing of Kings-style buff
Pair with Cooking; wreckage also feeds Tailoring and Leatherworking
